summary.en: Anthropic's frontier models, now including Claude Fable 5 — first Mythos-class model open to the public. SWE-bench Verified 95.0%, 1M context, adaptive thinking. Best for complex agent workflows and high-stakes coding.
summary.zh: Anthropic 旗舰模型家族，最新加入 Claude Fable 5——首款对公众开放的 Mythos 级模型。SWE-bench Verified 95.0%，100 万 Token 上下文，自适应思考。最适合复杂 Agent 工作流和高要求代码任务。

title.en: Anthropic API Key — Claude Fable 5 & All Models Access | Get Model Key
title.zh: Anthropic API Key——Claude Fable 5 及全系列模型入口 | Get Model Key

description.en: Get your Anthropic API key for Claude Fable 5 and all Claude models. Fable 5: Mythos-class frontier model, SWE-bench 95%, 1M context.
description.zh: 获取 Anthropic Claude Fable 5 及全系列模型的官方 API Key。Fable 5：Mythos 级前沿模型，SWE-bench 95%，百万 Token 上下文。

en: Anthropic builds the Claude family, including Claude Fable 5 (Mythos-class, public access), plus Sonnet, Opus, and Haiku lines for agents and coding.
Use the Anthropic Console when you want first-party Claude APIs with long context and adaptive thinking, without an AWS or third-party middle layer.
zh: Anthropic 打造 Claude 家族，包括对公众开放的 Mythos 级 Claude Fable 5，以及 Sonnet、Opus、Haiku 等，面向 Agent 与高要求编程。
若希望直连官方 Claude API、使用长上下文与自适应思考，而不经过 AWS 或第三方中间层，请使用 Anthropic Console。

en: Sign up or log in at console.anthropic.com.
Open Account → API Keys (console.anthropic.com/account/keys) and create a key.
Copy the secret immediately; Anthropic shows full key material only at creation time.
Call the Messages API with x-api-key (or SDK auth) using docs.anthropic.com guidance.
zh: 在 console.anthropic.com 注册或登录。
进入 Account → API Keys（console.anthropic.com/account/keys）创建密钥。
创建时立即复制完整密钥，之后通常无法再次查看明文。
按 docs.anthropic.com 说明，用 x-api-key 或官方 SDK 调用 Messages API。

question.en: Can one Anthropic key call Claude Fable 5 and older Claude models?
question.zh: 一把 Anthropic Key 能否同时调用 Fable 5 与其他 Claude？

answer.en: Keys issued in the Anthropic Console are used across Claude models your workspace is allowed to call; confirm Fable 5 availability in the console.
answer.zh: Console 签发的 Key 可用于工作区已开通的 Claude 模型；Fable 5 是否可用请在控制台确认。

question.en: Where do I read Claude API docs?

answer.en: Official docs are at https://docs.anthropic.com/. Keys are managed at https://console.anthropic.com/account/keys.
